limitations: Grade-separated road and bridge meshes, modeled entrance protrusions and sculpture-specific masks still require a shared final exclusion contract.
Crown circles are conservative screening envelopes. Overhang above an ordinary road is not automatically a 3D collision; verify template geometry and intended clearance before removing trees.
Mapped building footprints do not encode every passage or colonnade. Footprint hits require actual source/GLB and local-view confirmation.
